prompt: Who had their twenty-first number one hit on the US Billboard Hot Country Songs chart the same week Carly Rae Jepsen hit #39 on the Australia ARIA Top 50 Singles chart?
answer: Keith Urban. In the chart week of July 18–19, 2015, Urban’s **“John Cougar, John Deere, John 3:16”** became his 21st No. 1 on Billboard’s **Hot Country Songs** chart, while Carly Rae Jepsen’s “I Really Like You” was at No. 39 on Australia’s ARIA Singles Chart.
